actionable_comment_findings.mismatch: Guide treats ownership defaults as mandatory readback policy and claims uncaptured-handler-only error delivery. Public blocking_validation can be overridden on native; borrowed/browser scope skipping can leave a matching caller scope to capture the error. Root context docs already state configured-error-handling policy.
actionable_comment_findings.proposed_wording: Native contexts that own their device read back the validation scope before returning by default. Borrowed contexts disable this blocking readback by default, and browser builds omit it. On these paths, native failures follow the device's configured error handling, including caller-installed scopes, rather than a synchronous `TextureViewError`.

sdk_evidence.fresh_coverage: lines638-688 complete error routing method/default handler, plus supporting scope search locations
sdk_evidence.evidence: SDK routes Validation to innermost matching scope before custom/default uncaptured handling; no matching scope is required for handler path.

reconciled_contracts.evidence: Three texture shapes retain controlled allocation/cache/metadata/native Device. Stored-format requests cache-first and Arc-sharing, including detached allocation; missing cache returns MissingView. Alternate views require native allocation and creating Device, keep original request/native cause and map storage sRGB request only at descriptor boundary. Cube face/array geometry and SelectedTextureView effective format/dimension/Device retained. No global/native/calibrated-color acceptance promise.

ValidationScope waits once then always pops and preserves PollError plus captured error. Recorder scopes alone do not prove deferred encoder acceptance. WgpuContext.submit scopes finish and submission independently without completion wait. Public native policy can override constructor defaults. Borrowed/browser device handling does not provide synchronous validation verdict. No rollback/global-health promise for command recording, cached slots, conversion or prior cube face upload. Completion marker/callback is separate; SDK WebGPU rejection still invokes callback.
